description:
Create an isometric projection drawing of a fire sprinkler riser in LibreCAD. 

Starting from absolute coordinate (200, 100), draw a continuous pipe run with the following segments on layer 'PIPE_CENTERLINE' (Color: Red):
1. Vertical UP (90 degrees) for 1000 mm.
2. Isometric LEFT/BACK (150 degrees) for 1200 mm.
3. Isometric RIGHT (30 degrees) for 800 mm.
4. Vertical DOWN (270 degrees) for 300 mm.

On layer 'FITTINGS' (Color: Cyan), draw:
- A Circle (Radius 40) at the junction of segments 1 and 2 (the top of the riser).
- A Circle (Radius 20) at the end of segment 4 (the drop).

On layer 'TEXT' (Color: White), add text labels:
- 'RISER' near the first vertical segment.
- 'DN 100' near the main horizontal run.

Save the drawing as '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/fire_riser_iso.dxf'.
